Retrieve Employee Details
30
Easy
Write a Java program to simulate retrieving employee details from a database using an employee ID.
Each employee contains:
Employee ID
Employee Name
Salary
The program should read N employee records and then read an employee ID to search.
If the employee exists, display:
Name: <name>
Salary: <salary>
If the employee does not exist, display:
Employee not found
